birdwatch.auto.hint: Looks again while the tab is open. It stops when the plugin is switched off, and an account posts a few times a day, so the slower settings are usually the right ones.
birdwatch.description: Watches accounts on Bluesky, Mastodon and Reddit, and any RSS feed with pictures in it, and drops what they post into the intake folder Kibble sorts. No login anywhere.
birdwatch.empty: Nothing yet. Add an account above and press Refresh. No login is needed: this reads the public feed of whoever you name.
birdwatch.handle.hint: A Bluesky handle or profile link, a fediverse address like someone@mastodon.social, u/name or r/name or a Reddit link, or the address of an RSS or Atom feed.
birdwatch.intake.hint: Saved pictures land here, which is the same folder Saucer uses, so Kibble sorts them with everything else.
birdwatch.pause.hint: Untick to pause: kept in the list, skipped on every look, its pictures left where they are.
birdwatch.status.seen: Not saved: the same picture already came in via {0}.
birdwatch.status.start: Add an account and press Refresh.
birdwatch.trial.found: @{0} on {1}: {2} posts on the last page, {3} pictures to save, {4} reposts; newest {5}.
birdwatch.trial.nothing: @{0} on {1}: nothing on the last page. Right account?
birdwatch.try.hint: Read the account's last page and say what it would save, without watching it.
birdwatch.video.note: Video comes as a stream or without its sound, so there is nothing here to save. The link opens the post.
